name: identity
command: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; cat /proc/cmdline; cat /sys/module/gts9_lastactivity/parameters/capture_id; cat /proc/1/wchan; timeout 5 systemctl --failed --no-pager

name: watchdog
command: for n in watchdog soft_watchdog softlockup_panic panic; do echo $n; cat /proc/sys/kernel/$n; done; cat /var/log/gts9-watchdog-debug.txt
